_comment: Supervisor-written, NOT generated. Claim a thread by adding an entry to 'claims'; release it by removing that entry. plan_file is the path as it appears in HANDOFF_MANIFEST.md (backticks optional); claimed_at is ISO-8601 UTC. Claims older than ~60 min are surfaced as stale by scripts/build_handoff_index.py so an abandoned claim is never silently trusted.
